environmentVariables.name: INVESTRA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Investra API key. Get one at https://www.investraapp.com/profile (Developer Settings). Format: starts with 'inv_' followed by 48 characters.

environmentVariables.name: INVESTRA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the Investra API base URL. Defaults to https://www.investraapp.com. Set this only if you're running the Investra web app locally for development.
